profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Airbnb
profile.summary: Experienced Organizer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Haskell, JVM languages, Ruby, Web Applications, and Computer Science. Strong community and social services professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science from Universidad Central de Venezuela.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Kubernetes · Golang · Software Design

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Re-organization of the Droplet Scheduler service, went from running three instances handling all DO regions to a  per-region, redundant deployment using Kubernetes. 

• Re-architecture of the Hypervisor reporting mechanism. Evolved from a UDP protocol to a TCP protocol using gRPC streaming, offering better consistency semantics and distribution of reports across multiple services

• Reliability Enhancement across all our services by introducing: 
    ✓ Bulkheading and automatic restart of various dependencies using an in-process Supervision Tree library that I developed in golang
    ✓ A parallel read-only production infrastructure for performing harness testing using chaos engineering
     ✓ Scripting and Automation of Grafanna dashboard generation using Jsonnet to add consistency and ease of use to dashboards
     ✓ Gameday exercises within the team to build intuition of production runtime and incident management skills

• Architect, Implement, Deploy and Maintain an in-house reverse proxy implementation for unary gRPC APIs. This proxy allowed us to perform canary tests and execute CI/CD using Concourse + gRPC meta API.

• Architect, Implement, Deploy and Maintain a service responsible for Droplet migration monitoring. We used this service to perform preventive maintenance and performance Droplet migrations for better resource utilization of Hypervisor hardware.

• Enhance the development environment setup for new team members using the Nix package manager and build a distributed cache infrastructure using CI (GitHub Actions) plus Droplets running a Nix Store server.
positions.insights: Skills: Reliability Engineering · nix · Go (Programming Language) · gRPC · System Architecture

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Development of a cryptocurrency Wallet prototype made in Haskell 
• Collaboration in the development of a Blockchain in Haskell
• Development in Haskell Open Source projects with a strategic value for the company
• Planning and Project Management for various clients using Gitlab
• Collaborate in the company's official blog site
• Host a Webinar exposing FP Complete's Development workflows and practices

positions.title: Main Organizer
positions.description:
Started this meetup to embrace the Haskell knowledge in the Vancouver area, this has bring really smart people together to discuss not just Haskell, but other programming languages as well. Have done many of the presentations of this Meetup, specially the basic ones regarding Monads, Functors and not so basic ones like Cloud Haskell and the enumerator library.

https://www.meetup.com/Vancouver-Haskell-Unmeetup/

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Upgrade company's Haskell codebase of ~90k loc from GHC-7.10 to GHC-8.0
• Improve performance of Jenkins CI pipeline reducing building time by a factor of 70%
• Add a holistic performance test using JMeter and Gradle to our CI pipeline
• Migrate database infrastructure from AWS RDS Postgres to Aurora Postgres

positions.title: Backend Chapter Lead
positions.description:
Responsibilities of the Role:

• Discover and remove blockers that stop teams from delivering business value   
• Document processes and gather knowledge from backend teams’ experiences   
• Provide support around microservices system architectures
• Plan workshop sessions around technologies being used inside Unbounce (Clojure, RxJS, Elm)

positions.title: API & Integrations Tech Lead
positions.description:
• Development and installation of a new Javascript Heavy Client component on top of an existing _Server Rendered UI_ to manage different third-party integrations with Unbounce (MailChimp, Zappier, among others). This client was developed using React and Redux.

• Development of a REST HTTP API that dispatched work to other microservices in the system via SQS queues and a PostgreSQL database. This server was developed in Clojure and hosted by AWS.

• Development of a microservice that delivered Form Submissions to customer Webhook URLs, this microservice stabilized the overall health of the Unbounce production by siloing errors from customers webhooks. The development was done in Clojure on top of AWS (EC2, SQS, SNS).  This application managed 30% of the 3rd party integrations created in Unbounce Landing Pages.

• Development of a data pipeline that kept in-sync a newly created integrations microservice with our legacy Rails application. We used AWS (SNS, SQS) to manage the communication between the monolith and microservices

• Development of a feature flag service that allowed us to gradually deploy new and experimental projects, all new company projects went through this feature flag system that seated on top of AWS S3 and had notification transports in SNS and SQS 

• Improvements and bug fixing of various legacy 3rd Party Integrations in Ruby

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Development and deployment of a Microservices Architecture in Clojure, intended to migrate concerns from our Rails monolith to various microservices

• Collaborated on the development of an API Router system that receives requests through Unbounce public API and redirects them to internal/private HTTP servers, it also performed schema transformations for compliance and RAML (https://raml.org/) verification on test environments. 

• Collaborated on the development of a fat javascript client responsible of displaying Form Submissions received from Landing Pages and their interactions with various 3rd party integrations, used VirtualDom and RxJS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Development of a CSV export JRuby Microservice using the Vert.x framework, this service performs CSV exports of the Form Submissions received by Unbounce's Landing Pages

• Extend the Rails monolith with a new third-party integration (Marketo) and implemented the delivery of form submissions received from Unbounce Landing Pages using their developer API. This integration became the third most popular inside the Unbouce platform.

• Development and release of Unbounce's WordPress Plugin, which allowed our customers to connect their Unbounce account and serve their Landing Pages in their WordPress installation. This project is used by almost 50% of all Unbounce users.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Development of maestro.io, a tool for instant feedback for Front-End developers.  Orchestrated different processes to accomplish great collaboration between editor and browser:

• Use a pool of PhantomJS processes to recreate Live CSS style changes using frozen dom snapshots
• Use a pool of ngrok processes to share current development workflow with the Internet
• TCP Socket Management to communicate different editors (Sublime, Emacs) with an HTTP Server done in Haskell
• WebSockets to communicate the HTTP Server with Google Chrome
• Google Chrome extension to inject dynamic content (CSS/JS/HTML) from your editor using Clojurescript and RxJS.

The implementation of all the services was done using an Actor infrastructure on top of Cloud Haskell (OTP like API for Haskell), also an in-house implementation of the Bayeux protocol in Haskell was used to allow communication between older versions of IE to the Haskell HTTP Server.

positions.title: Main Organizer
positions.description:
I gathered many of the developers on the Haskell Meetup and proposed a hack night every week to learn Clojure and produce new open source software from our learning experience.

http://van-clj.github.io/

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
noomii.com started as a Website that offered tools for people to easily do "pair coaching".  This product later pivoted to a Directory of Life Coaches. In the time I was working there we managed to make it one of the goto websites to find a Life Coach, listing thousands of them from different countries and cities.

Among the many tasks I had:

* Created a Puppet infrastructure to easily spawn new developer and production environments in minutes
* Developed an extensive test-suite over all the existing source code, and promoted test-driven principles to the rest of the team
* Managed all their backend services using AWS EC2/S3
* Worked with Redis and Resque to handle asynchronous jobs
* Created the GeoLocation infrastructure for the directory
* Did measured improvements to improve  Website performance for SEO purposes
* Developed a Crawler using Haskell for debugging common SEO penalties on the main Website

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
has_many :developers was one of the consulting companies that was an early adopters of Rails. They had  many startup clients looking to have great quality developers on lower fares.

Some of the work I did:

* Worked with Merb on the early stages GreenWalla, a green social network
* Worked on the backend of SugarStats.com with integration with multiple social networks (Facebook, Twitter)  
* Implementation of a distributed authentication server using OpenID and LDAP with Ruby on Rails
* Worked with MuisqBase.com on the early development of their Startup.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Terabrain was a startup that worked on the development of a space for contractors and developers to meet and formalize businesses online. The work I did was to develop a service to send SMS messages fro the Web using JEE, Hibernate and Struts
